name: branch-janitor
description: Watches your git branches by itself (nothing to run) and notices when a branch's work is done (merged, squash-merged, pull request merged), even if you merged in a plain terminal. Checks it is safe to delete and offers to delete it. Never deletes without a click; the remote copy is a second, separate question.

minMinutes.title: Minutes between looks
minMinutes.description: Quiet looks (after Claude pulls, pushes or switches branch, or at session start) happen at most once per repository per this many minutes. A merge, a pull request merged, or any change to your branches always gets a look at once.

protectedBranches.title: Protected branches
protectedBranches.description: Never offered for deletion; * matches any text. Leave empty for the built-in list: main, master, develop, dev, trunk, release/*, gh-pages. Setting any value replaces that list.

staleDays.title: Quiet days to list as stale
staleDays.description: '/branch-janitor' lists unmerged branches untouched for more than this many days (information only).
